ARC is a public Skills-first deployment architecture.

Before substantive work:
1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. For onboarding/deployment/diagnosis, use `.github/skills/atlas/SKILL.md`.
3. For ordinary bounded work, treat the current authorised instruction as sufficient authority and execute directly; do not ask twice merely because state will change.
4. Treat `--apply` as a deliberate mutation-mode selector, not a second human approval step.
5. Stop for fresh authority only at a real destructive/root/private-data/spend/legal/client-commitment boundary; credentials alone never create authority.
6. Never commit secret values or private business/client/personnel data.
7. Preserve one owner for each class of truth.
8. Prefer normal authorised tools/APIs before privileged runtime infrastructure.
9. Verify real state before claiming success.
